2610.06830.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
2610.06830.paper_summary: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.
2610.06830.paper_summary_zh: 記憶已成為 LLM 代理生態系統的核心，支持在互動中保留和重用信息。<lb/>然而，大多數現有的代理記憶系統以與查詢無關的方式構建記憶，這可能會產生不必要的預處理成本並丟棄後來證明至關重要的細節。<lb/>最近的研究已開始將記憶處理轉向運行時適應，但通常專注於特定操作或固定處理方案，對性能、成本和延遲的靈活控制仍然未得到充分探索。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了 \textbf{MemPilot}，一個靈活的框架，根據不同的性能--成本--延遲偏好協調按需的記憶策劃。<lb/>具體而言，我們通過增強學習優化多步 LLM 策略，以迭代方式在從與查詢無關的記憶中檢索和將查詢特定的原始多模態歷史策劃委託給異構 LLM 和 VLM 之間進行選擇。<lb/>該策略共同控制證據數量、策劃指令、模型選擇和視覺訪問，實現運行時計算的細粒度分配。<lb/>為了在競爭目標下優化這一策略，我們通過在聚合之前分別估計每個目標的優勢來適應目標優勢解耦。此外，我們引入基於前綴的邊際效用估計，以便在多步展開中進行細粒度的信用分配。<lb/>在五個多模態代理記憶基準上的實驗顯示，在優化偏好下，性能--成本--延遲的權衡表現良好，偏好掃描產生的邊界比現有的權衡感知基準更廣泛。
